name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold development company advancing the Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina toward first production. The Diablillos project is fully permitted with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study and is one of the largest undeveloped primary silver-gold projects in the Americas. The company is in the development stage and is targeting first production in 2029.
